name: hud_layout_node_apply_image_widget
description: HudUiLayoutNode::ApplyImageWidget applies a HUD image layout array to a widget with base and anchor offsets, optional visibility/centering flags, borrowed image reuse, invalidation, and output rectangle reporting.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this helper is deferred to a coherent HUD layout/source-cluster tier S pass.
Binary Ninja still has SBB flag-lift warnings for the original inline strcmp-style TRUE comparisons, so functional evidence is based on assembly review plus native behavior tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x413d30 validates rejecting non-array nodes, reading image path/x/y from payload[1..3], adding base and optional anchor offsets, parsing payload[4] and payload[5] as TRUE flags when payload[0] is 6, reusing a preloaded image or loading by path, optionally centering by signed half image dimensions, calling the widget SetPos and Invalidate slots, writing the low image-state word, and returning/writing the image rect.

The native smoke verifies the borrowed-image path with TRUE visibility and centering, default flag behavior for a four-field layout, output rectangle dimensions, and the non-array early return preserving existing widget and rect state.
